companyDescription: AI Operating System for Government + Enterprise · AIP boot camps → 75% conversion · Pentagon + DHS + USDA AI contract dominance
priceNote: Down 43% from $207 52-wk high — recovering off $106 low after DHS $1B + NVIDIA partnership news
summary: Palantir posted its 11th consecutive quarter of accelerating revenue (+85% YoY Q1) backed by a DHS $1B blanket AI contract, Pentagon program-of-record status, and USDA $300M deal. Analyst consensus $182 implies +57% upside from a -43% drawdown low. Q2 earnings Aug 10 is the next catalyst — but the 3-consecutive sell-the-news pattern demands caution on sizing.

catalysts.name: DHS $1B AI Blanket Purchase Agreement
catalysts.description: 5-year DHS BPA covering CBP, FEMA, ICE and all sub-agencies. No separate competitive bids needed — revenue ramp begins now with each task order. Largest government AI contract in company history.

catalysts.name: Q2 2026 Earnings
catalysts.description: Guide: $1.797–1.801B revenue; consensus $1.81B. Watch US commercial >$650M (Q1=$595M) and FY guide raise above $7.65B for a sustained rally.

catalysts.name: NVIDIA Sovereign AI Partnership
catalysts.description: Joint initiative to deliver intelligent sovereign AI environments with NVIDIA AI + Nemotron models. Expands AIP addressable market to non-US government sovereign cloud buyers globally.

catalysts.name: USDA $300M Blanket Purchase Agreement
catalysts.description: National Farm Security Action Plan — AIP across all USDA agencies. Revenue recognition begins Q2–Q3 2026.

risks: Sell-the-news pattern — 3 consecutive earnings beats produced -7% to -12% day-of reactions (most recent: Q1 -6.93%)
Extreme valuation — 260x forward PE, 102x P/S; bears argue fair value $40–70; any growth deceleration = violent compression
UK/EU regulatory risk — Metropolitan Police £50M contract blocked Jun 12; NHS under scrutiny; European market may close
Expectations bar sky-high — Polymarket had 94% beat odds for Q1; Q2 needs >$1.85B guide lift to get a positive reaction
Hyperscaler competition — Azure AI, AWS Bedrock, Databricks all building enterprise AI tools eroding PLTR's moat
Government budget risk — US contracts ~55% of revenue; DOGE reviews + CR uncertainty can delay new task orders
Michael Burry 'sand castle' call (June 4) went viral — elevated retail sentiment risk

estimateDates.note: Guide $1.797–1.801B; consensus $1.81B — real beat bar is >$1.85B + FY guide raise
US Commercial ≥$3.224B (+120% YoY) — watch QoQ acceleration

macroRisk.rateOutlook: Fed at 3.50–3.75%; Warsh removed easing bias Jun 17. Rate-sensitive high-multiple software at risk from any hike signal at Jul 29 FOMC.
macroRisk.inflationNote: Core PCE 3.4% (3-yr high). Government contracts (55% of revenue) are inflation-insulated. Commercial pipeline could slow if macro deteriorates.
macroRisk.sectorImpact: High-multiple software most sensitive to rate moves. PLTR's 260x PE compresses rapidly on any Fed hawkishness. Government revenue is secular and less cyclical.
macroRisk.summary: MEDIUM — Fed hawkish tilt pressures 260x PE. Government revenue anchor (~55%) provides partial insulation. Commercial pipeline depends on enterprise AI adoption continuing.

spotSizing.reason: High upside potential (+57% consensus) but extreme valuation (260x PE) + sell-the-news pattern. Limit to 3–4% of portfolio. Scale in on dips, not a lump-sum play.
